metaTitle: Custom Screen Print Sweaters & Cardigans | Perfect Imprints
metaDescription: Order custom screen print sweaters and cardigans for your team. Perfect for uniforms, events, and gifts. Bulk pricing available.
introHtml: Screen printing is a cost-effective decoration method for bulk sweater and cardigan orders, delivering vibrant, durable designs that hold up wash after wash. Whether you're outfitting a sales team for a winter trade show or creating holiday gifts for employees, screen print allows crisp logos and text on cotton or cotton-blend knits. Choose from crewnecks, v-necks, or zip-front cardigans in a variety of colors to match your brand palette. This method works best for designs with limited colors and solid fills, giving you a professional look without the premium cost of embroidery.
heroAltText: Custom screen print sweaters and cardigans with company logo in navy blue, displayed on mannequins at a corporate event.
